## Pull request overview Release integration for **v0.9.0** centered on hardening core operations so **profile launchers and user-data directories survive edits/removals/renames**, including symlink/case-folding edge cases, and improving user-facing reporting for “data kept” outcomes. **Changes:** - Make launcher/icon handling robust: content-addressed badge resources, improved icon cache refresh flow, and wrapper version bump. - Allow edits/rebuilds while a profile is running by reporting **live rewrites** and adding an app-layer **“Restart to apply”** nudge. - Strengthen data-safety invariants around purge/remove (shared data, symlinks, unreadable launcher folders, default profile), with richer outcomes and tested notices. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 64 out of 64 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
